details.question: Combien y a-t-il d'artistes ?
details.generated_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS NbArtistes FROM Artist
LIMIT 200

details.question: Combien de clients habitent en France ?
details.generated_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS NbClients FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'France'
LIMIT 200

details.question: Quelle est la piste la plus longue ?
details.generated_sql: SELECT Name, Milliseconds FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1

details.question: Quel est le montant moyen d'une facture ?
details.generated_sql:
SELECT AVG(Total) AS MontantMoyen FROM Invoice
LIMIT 200

details.question: Combien de pistes durent plus de 5 minutes ?
details.generated_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > 5 * 60 * 1000
LIMIT 200

details.question: Quels sont les albums du groupe AC/DC ?
details.generated_sql:
SELECT Album.Title FROM Album JOIN Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId WHERE Artist.Name = 'AC/DC'
LIMIT 200

details.question: Combien de pistes appartiennent au genre Jazz ?
details.generated_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track JOIN Genre ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId WHERE Genre.Name = 'Jazz'
LIMIT 200

details.question: Quels sont les 2 pays qui ont le plus de factures ?
details.generated_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, COUNT(*) AS NbFactures FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY NbFactures DESC LIMIT 2

details.question: Quels sont les 3 artistes qui ont le plus d'albums ?
details.generated_sql: SELECT Artist.Name, COUNT(*) AS NbAlbums FROM Artist JOIN Album ON Artist.ArtistId = Album.ArtistId GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId ORDER BY NbAlbums DESC LIMIT 3

details.question: Quel est le chiffre d'affaires de chaque année ?
details.generated_sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS Year, SUM(Total) AS TotalSales FROM Invoice GROUP BY Year
LIMIT 200

details.question: Quels pays comptent au moins 5 clients ?
details.generated_sql:
SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS NbClients FROM Customer GROUP BY Country HAVING NbClients >= 5
LIMIT 200

details.question: Quels sont les noms de famille des 5 clients qui ont dépensé le plus ?
details.generated_sql: SELECT Customer.LastName, SUM(Invoice.Total) AS TotalSpent FROM Invoice JOIN Customer ON Invoice.CustomerId = Customer.CustomerId GROUP BY Customer.CustomerId ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC LIMIT 5

details.question: Pour chaque employé qui suit des clients, donne son nom de famille et le nombre de clients qu'il suit.
details.generated_sql:
SELECT Employee.LastName, COUNT(Customer.CustomerId) AS NbClients FROM Employee JOIN Customer ON Employee.EmployeeId = Customer.SupportRepId GROUP BY Employee.EmployeeId
LIMIT 200

details.question: Combien d'artistes n'ont aucun album ?
details.generated_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS NbArtistesSansAlbum FROM Artist WHERE ArtistId NOT IN (SELECT ArtistId FROM Album)
LIMIT 200

details.question: Quel artiste a généré le plus de revenus ?
details.generated_sql: SELECT Artist.Name, SUM(InvoiceLine.UnitPrice * InvoiceLine.Quantity) AS Revenus FROM InvoiceLine JOIN Track ON InvoiceLine.TrackId = Track.TrackId JOIN Album ON Track.AlbumId = Album.AlbumId JOIN Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId ORDER BY Revenus DESC LIMIT 1
